emotion: Curious and excited, head tilted toward the flower bed, one forepaw lifted

text: I think it’s a little kitty! Let’s say hello!
translation: 我想那是一只小猫咪！我们去打个招呼吧！
emotion: Warm and encouraging, leaning slightly toward Soda, one wing gesturing forward

text: Hi, Kitty! My name is Soda. What’s your name?
translation: 嗨，小猫咪！我叫小苏打。你叫什么名字呀？
emotion: Friendly and a little shy, tail wagging slowly, ears forward

text: Meow! Hi! I’m Mimi. Nice to meet you!
translation: 喵！你们好！我叫小咪。很高兴认识你！
emotion: Bright and curious, one small meow first, then a happy greeting, tail tip flicking

text: Nice to meet you, too! You’re so cute!
translation: 我们也很高兴认识你！你真可爱呀！
emotion: Cheerful and welcoming, a small happy hop in place

text: Thank you! I love your fluffy fur, Soda!
translation: 谢谢你！小苏打，我好喜欢你毛茸茸的皮毛呀！
emotion: Happy and a bit proud, leaning a little closer to look at Soda

text: Thank you! Do you want to play with us?
translation: 谢谢你！你想和我们一起玩吗？
emotion: Hopeful and inviting, tail wagging faster, front paws together

translation: 真的吗？耶！我好想和你们一起玩呀！
emotion: Surprised then delighted, eyes wide, little bounce

translation: 太棒啦！现在我们是朋友啦！
emotion: Joyful and proud, wings up in a little cheer

text: Come on, Mimi! Let’s play together!
translation: 来吧，小咪！我们一起玩吧！
emotion: Eager and playful, turning to lead the way, tail high

text: Wait for me! Here I come!
emotion: Excited and running, bell jingling, tail streaming behind
